edges.reason: msg.sender is used to set _owner and mint the initial reflection supply.
maxtx authorization relies on _msgSender() == _teamAddress.
manualswap authorization relies on _msgSender() == _teamAddress.
manualsend authorization relies on _msgSender() == _teamAddress.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of funds.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for allowance decrement.
approve uses _msgSender() as allowance owner.
_msgSender() is passed as the spender into _approve.
_transfer gates uniswap buys with cooldown[to] < block.timestamp.
cooldown[to] is written as block.timestamp + 120 seconds.
Router deadline for the fee swap is set to block.timestamp.
addLiquidityETH deadline is set to block.timestamp.
maxTxpc is scaled by mul/div to derive _maxTxAmount.
Amount argument flows from transfer into _transfer.
Sender argument flows into _transfer and allowance accounting.
Amount argument flows into _transfer and the allowance subtraction.
Spender argument flows into _approve.
bots_ array elements are written into the bots mapping.
onoff boolean is written into cooldownEnabled.
tokenAmount flows into approval and the router swap call.
amount is split by two and sent to the two wallets.
from address is used for bot, fee and pair checks.
to address is used for cooldown and fee checks.
amount is compared against _maxTxAmount before transfer.
tAmount is decomposed by _getValues into r/t amounts.
contractTokenBalance is computed then passed to the external swap call.
currentRate scales tTeam into the rTeam credited to the contract.
rSupply is initialized from _rTotal and returned.
tSupply is initialized from _tTotal and returned.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer before adjusting allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance.
approve delegates to _approve.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_transfer performs an external swap mid-transfer before final accounting.
_transfer sends ETH to external wallets inside the transfer path.
_transfer hands off to _tokenTransfer for final settlement.
_isExcludedFromFee determines whether takeFee is true.
cooldown mapping is read and written based on block.timestamp.
_maxTxAmount bounds the transfer amount.
inSwap swap guard is checked before swapping.
swapEnabled decides whether the auto swap runs.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to and msg.sender.
bots blacklist is checked for from and to.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard credits the team portion via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies the reflection fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard subtracts and adds _rOwned balances.
_takeTeam reads the current rate via _getRate.
_takeTeam increases _rOwned of the contract address.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal and adds tFee to _tFeeTotal.
_getValues calls _getRate for the current rate.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply for r/t supply.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading stores the router instance.
openTrading stores the created pair address.
openTrading performs an unbounded external approve on the pair token.
openTrading makes an external payable addLiquidityETH call.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router fee swap.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to two external wallets.
manualswap lets the team trigger the external swap at will.
manualsend lets the team trigger external ETH transfers at will.
setBots writes the bots mapping.
setCooldownEnabled writes cooldownEnabled.
maxtx rewrites _maxTxAmount and is guarded by team address check.
maxtx compares the caller against _teamAddress.
balanceOf reads _rOwned of the account.
constructor mints _rOwned to the deployer.
constructor sets _isExcludedFromFee entries.
constructor assigns _teamAddress.
constructor assigns _marketingFunds.
The router swap returns ETH to the token contract and can re-enter _transfer before accounting completes.
ETH transfers to team/marketing wallets can execute fallback code that re-enters _transfer.
The external addLiquidityETH call during openTrading can re-enter the token's transfer path.
